issues.description: Field 'status_flag': the problem statement (problem_statement.md) explicitly requires defining status_flag as a single byte ('status_flag db ...'), but the provided solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) declares it as a 4-byte doubleword ('status_flag dd 1'). The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) does not declare status_flag at all. This mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the correct size to use and may cause tests or subsequent code to behave unexpectedly if they rely on a 1-byte flag.
issues.suggestedFix: Align artifacts to the problem statement: declare status_flag as a single byte. Update solution_repository/helloWorld.asm to 'status_flag db 1' instead of 'status_flag dd 1', and add a matching declaration to template_repository/helloWorld.asm (e.g. add 'status_flag db 1' inside the .data section). Alternatively, if a 4-byte flag was intentional, update the problem statement to state that status_flag is a 4-byte doubleword and document the reason.
